song.name: Primal Pact
song.plot: Cast into Eldoria, Acheron gathers a circle of loyal disciples among early human noble bloodlines. In a subterranean cavern, he proposes a pact to transcend mortality and share divine longevity.
song.analysis: The original is a generic vampire gathering ("pledging power and loyalty to a new order"). The reworked version anchors it to Acheron's specific recruiting pitch: human noble bloodlines in a subterranean cavern, the sacred vow, and the promise of shared divine longevity. Preserves the Suno meter and 4-verse structure. Suggested song direction: atmospheric, solemn, mysterious — low strings, cavern reverb, chant-like chorus.

section.name: Verse 1
